docker.overview: Containerization platform to build, ship, and run distributed applications anywhere.
recommended_topics: Dockerfile best practices & multi-stage builds
Docker Compose for multi-container development
Volume management & container networking
Image optimization and vulnerability scanning
docker.hands_on_project: Containerize a full-stack FastAPI + React app with PostgreSQL using Docker Compose and persistent volumes.

kubernetes.overview: Automate deployment, scaling, and management of containerized workloads.
recommended_topics: Pods, Deployments, and ReplicaSets
Services, Ingress Controllers, and Cluster Networking
ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Helm Charts
Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) and Resource Limits
kubernetes.hands_on_project: Deploy a multi-tier microservice architecture to local Minikube or kind cluster with Ingress and HPA.

fastapi.overview: Modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints.
recommended_topics: Dependency Injection system and async endpoints
Pydantic V2 schema validation and serialization
OAuth2 JWT authentication & role-based access control
Background tasks and Celery integration
fastapi.hands_on_project: Build an asynchronous rate-limited REST API with Redis caching and OpenAPI documentation.

postgresql.overview: Advanced open-source relational database supporting SQL, JSON queries, indexing, and high concurrency.
recommended_topics: Advanced indexing (B-Tree, GIN, BRIN) and EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Database normalization, foreign keys, and cascading
Transactions, ACID compliance, and isolation levels
JSONB querying and full-text search indexing

courses_or_docs.title: Use The Index, Luke! (SQL Indexing Guide)

postgresql.hands_on_project: Design a relational schema with complex JOINs, materialized views, and partition tables.

scikit-learn.overview: Gold standard Python library for classical machine learning, feature engineering, and statistical modeling.
recommended_topics: Supervised vs Unsupervised learning algorithms
Feature scaling, encoding, and Pipelines
Hyperparameter tuning with GridSearchCV and cross-validation
Evaluation metrics (ROC-AUC, F1-Score, Confusion Matrix)
scikit-learn.hands_on_project: Train an end-to-end churn prediction pipeline with feature transformers and model persistence via Joblib.

react.overview: Declarative, component-based JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
recommended_topics: React 18 hooks: useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback
Custom hooks and global state management (Zustand/Redux)
Component lifecycle, lazy loading, and error boundaries
TypeScript integration and strict prop typing

courses_or_docs.title: Epic React by Kent C. Dodds

react.hands_on_project: Build a responsive analytics dashboard with live search filtering, pagination, and Recharts.

aws.overview: Leading cloud platform providing scalable compute, storage, databases, and managed services.
recommended_topics: EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda serverless functions
VPC networking, Subnets, Route Tables, and Security Groups
IAM roles, policies, and least-privilege security
CloudWatch monitoring, alarms, and cost optimization

courses_or_docs.title: AWS Skill Builder & Free Tier Workshops

aws.hands_on_project: Deploy a containerized application to AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer.

ci/cd.overview: Automated pipeline for continuous code integration, automated testing, and seamless deployment.
recommended_topics: GitHub Actions workflow syntax and triggers
Matrix builds and automated test suites
Security secrets management and deployment keys
Zero-downtime rolling and canary deployments
ci/cd.hands_on_project: Write a multi-stage GitHub Actions workflow that lints, tests, builds Docker image, and deploys on git push.

default.overview: Industry standard technical competency required for modern software engineering and data roles.
recommended_topics: Core architectural fundamentals and syntax
Best design patterns and idiomatic implementations
Debugging, profiling, and performance tuning
Integration with automated unit and integration tests
default.hands_on_project: Build a portfolio project demonstrating real-world usage and document it with unit tests in GitHub.
